name: nexora_analysis_profiles_list
description: List installed immutable analysis profile versions. Available from Developer with analysis-profiles:read and explicit global key scope. Read the applicable repository profile/issue report first.

name: nexora_analysis_profile_get
description: Read a complete installed portable model for the development AI to improve. No secrets or server files. Requires analysis-profiles:read and global key scope.

name: nexora_analysis_profile_install
description: Validate and compile then install an immutable model version, available from Developer with analysis-profiles:contribute and global key scope. No human approval. Existing key/version cannot be overwritten. Automatic repositories choose latest compatible version on their NEXT synchronization; active snapshots and manual assignments remain pinned. Structural validation does not prove semantic coverage: test original failed examples and regressions locally first. 256KiB MCP limit.

name: nexora_repository_analysis_issues
description: Read a bounded page of failed/uncovered files, exact reasons and model version identifiers from the last authorized repository snapshot. Use repository code/evidence tools or local checkout at the reported commit to inspect original code, then extend and validate models. Never silently change business source to satisfy a parser.
